pr.title: docs: fix README typo
pr.body:
Hi there 👋

Great library, I like you style! I've written a similar one (although it's limited to environment variables), maybe we could share some inspiration.

Would you like some assistance with any of the open issues? I'd be happy to help!

diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index d7b048d..60452ad 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ Simple, useful and opinionated config loader.
 
 ## Rationale
 
-There are many solutions regarding configuration loading in Go. I was looking for a simple loader that is as easy to use and understand as possible. The goal was to load config from 4 places: defaults (in the code), files, environment variables, command-line flags. This library works with all of this sources.

explanation.what: README.md の Rationale 節にある文法の誤り "This library works with all of this sources" を "...all of these sources" に修正した。
explanation.why: PR タイトルが "docs: fix README typo" の通り、単純な誤字修正。PR body は挨拶とライブラリへの賞賛が中心で、動機はタイトル以上のものはない。
